articles.summary: STAMFORD, Conn., Nov. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Tronox Holdings plc (NYSE: TROX), the world’s leading integrated manufacturer of titanium dioxide pigment, announced today that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.05 per share.
